en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 447 - It is narrated from Fadhl from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr from Abul Hasan Imam Ali Ridha (a.s) that he said: “
Among the signs of the relief is an event, which will occur between the two mosques (of Mecca and Medina). So-and-so from the descendants of so-and-so will kill fifteen leaders of the Arabs.”
